intro: Opt Out Of Spokeo People Search begins by locating the exact public listing and using Spokeo's own privacy or removal channel. A broker opt-out can affect display on that service, but it does not erase source public records or automatically remove copies held by other sites.

sections.heading: Find the matching Spokeo listing
sections.body: Search only for your own information or a record you are authorized to manage. Compare enough public fields to select the right Spokeo listing, then save its exact page URL and the date you observed it before starting a removal request.

sections.heading: Submit the official privacy request
sections.body: Open the linked Spokeo opt-out or privacy page and follow its current steps to request suppression or removal of the matching record. Provide only the details the official form requires, use an email account you can access for verification, and do not send sensitive identity documents to MyRecon.

sections.heading: Verify removal and check other copies
sections.body: Save any confirmation message or reference number from Spokeo, then revisit the listing after the stated processing period. Repeat the check periodically because broker records can be refreshed, and submit separate requests to other services where you find a matching record.

faq.question: Does this remove my information from every website?
faq.answer: No. A request to Spokeo applies to the service and record covered by its procedure. Source records, search-engine copies, and other brokers can remain separate, so check each original page and submit a separate request when needed.

faq.question: How can I confirm a Spokeo removal request worked?
faq.answer: Save the official confirmation or request reference, revisit the exact Spokeo listing after the provider's stated processing period, and check any separate search result. If the page remains, follow the provider's current escalation or repeat-request instructions.

faq.question: Should I send identity documents to MyRecon?
faq.answer: No. Submit information only through the service's official privacy channel and only when its current process requires it. MyRecon does not collect identity documents for this request; keep a copy of any material you provide directly to the provider.

steps: Open Spokeo's official page linked here and follow its current instructions for the exact listing or account. Confirm that the record belongs to you or that you are authorized to make the request, and save its URL and date before submitting.

Submit the removal request through the official form, select the matching record, and complete the verification steps that the service currently requires. Share only required information through that official channel; do not send identity documents or credentials to MyRecon.
